name: Radiology Report Summarizer
description: Fine-tuned a T5-base model to generate the Impression section of chest X-ray reports from their Findings, trained on the Open-i dataset and served through a Flask REST API with input validation to reject non-medical text. Built with Python, Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, Flask, and deployed on Render.
